_format.level: feature(蓝框,新功能) | promo(绿框,免费模型活动) | info(默认) | warning(行为变更) | critical(紧急)

_format.titleEn/bodyEn: 可选英文；英文界面优先显示，缺省回退主字段
_format.link: 可选，显示「了解更多」按钮

items.title: 代理行为变更：不可直连渠道默认严格模式
items.body: Google Cloud Code、Gemini CLI 等渠道代理失败立即报错并顺位接力，不再回退直连死等（此前实测 788s）。连接级显式 strictProxy 优先。
items.titleEn: Proxy behavior change: direct-connect channels now default to strict mode
items.bodyEn: For channels that cannot connect directly (Google Cloud Code, Gemini CLI, …), a proxy failure now errors immediately and relays to the next account/combo member instead of hanging on a blocked direct connection (788s observed). Connection-level strictProxy overrides the default.

items.title: Qoder qfmodel 双线限免至 10-25
items.body: qfmodel 更名 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 1017，qoder / qoder-cn 国际国内双线限免（倍率 0x）至 10-25。
items.titleEn: Qoder qfmodel free on both lanes until 10-25
items.bodyEn: qfmodel is renamed DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 1017; free (0x rate) on both qoder and qoder-cn until 10-25.

items.title: CodeBuddy CN V4.1-Flash 1017 限免中
items.body: codebuddy-cn 的 V4.1-Flash 1017 限免窗口内倍率 0x，结束后恢复发布倍率。
items.bodyEn: codebuddy-cn's V4.1-Flash 1017 runs at 0x during the promo window and returns to the published rate afterwards.

items.title: MiniMax Code Free 回归
items.body: minimax-free 免登录网关线回归（CreditDaddy 闭环）；订阅线支持每日自动签到，模型面已对齐 M3.1 Flash 正式 id。
items.bodyEn: The minimax-free no-auth gateway lane is back (CreditDaddy closed loop); subscription lines gain daily auto check-in, and the model list is aligned to the official M3.1 Flash ids.

items.title: 新增 Inception Labs（Mercury 扩散模型）
items.body: OpenAI 兼容。mercury-3：1M ctx / 工具调用 / ~1000 tok/s，launch 半价 $0.10/$0.35，新 key 送 1 亿 tokens（额度经 CreditDaddy 通用卡推送）。
items.titleEn: New provider: Inception Labs (Mercury diffusion models)
items.bodyEn: OpenAI compatible. mercury-3: 1M ctx / tool calling / ~1000 tok/s, 50% off launch at $0.10/$0.35; new keys include 100M free tokens (quota via the CreditDaddy generic card).

items.title: 组合新增 router 策略
items.body: System One 决策模型前置路由，失败/超时自动退回原顺序；决策模型在组合卡上单独选择。
items.bodyEn: A System One decision model pre-routes each request; failures or timeouts silently fall back to the original order. Pick the decision model on the combo card.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 正式收录
items.body: Gemini 4 Argon 全线接入（gemini / vertex / antigravity 官方三线），支持常开推理与 1M 上下文；Codex 接入 GPT-6.1 Sol，采用全新极速 Responses Lite 协议传输。
items.titleEn: Gemini 4 Argon & GPT-6.1 Sol official support
items.bodyEn: Full Gemini 4 Argon support across gemini, vertex, and antigravity with always-on reasoning and 1M context; Codex adds GPT-6.1 Sol over the new Responses Lite transport protocol.

items.title: 端点模型白名单改勾选式
items.body: 端点「允许调用的模型与组合」由手敲 id 改为勾选式选择器。
items.titleEn: Endpoint model allowlist is now checkbox-based
items.bodyEn: The endpoint's allowed models/combos are picked via checkboxes instead of typing ids.

items.title: 外配额卡升级：单账号单卡 + 签到徽章
items.body: MiniMax Code Free 等推送卡改为每账号一张独立卡（余额不再跨账号加总），签到徽章紧贴余额数字；弹窗移动端居中体验对齐更新日志。
items.titleEn: Pushed quota cards: one card per account, badge beside the balance
items.bodyEn: Pushed cards (MiniMax Code Free and friends) are now one independent card per account — balances are no longer summed across accounts — with the check-in badge right beside the number; modals are now centered on mobile, matching the changelog dialog.

items.title: 社区与捐赠
items.body: 侧边栏新增 Community 分区：飞书群 / Discord / Telegram / GitHub。捐赠渠道：GitHub Sponsors / 爱发电 / 支付宝 / 微信。
items.bodyEn: New sidebar Community section: Feishu / Discord / Telegram / GitHub. Donations: GitHub Sponsors / AiFaDian / Alipay / WeChat.
